newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian O/N rates rise to end at 20.75 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian O/N rates rise to end at 20.75 pct.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates peaked at 21.00 percent on Wednesday due to tight liquidity but retreated to close at 20.75 percent, traders said. On Tuesday, overnight rates closed at 20.50 percent.

"Substantial funds are probably still tied up in the (central bank's) one-month reverse repo facility," said Gabor Liener of Raiffeisen Unicbank, adding that most players probably committed their money prior to the latest repo rate cut on June 6.
Liener also said that overnight rates were usually higher at the beginning of the banks' two-week reserve period.
Another trader said the repo rate cut might have arrived a little too early.
"It might be possible that the market was not ripe for a rate cut," said Erika Kaiser of Budapest Bank.
